Commercial Christmas Decorations  We offer a wide variety of wreaths, garland and Christmas decor in a variety of sizes! Our artificial wreaths and garland are lush and full of rich green color. They are perfect for hanging on a mantel, door or on the front of a large commercial building. Our outdoor red-velvet bows provide a warm, traditional complement to any outdoor lighting display. Our stringent manufacturing process ensures they keep their color and shape season after season.

Christmas GarlandOur heavy-duty exterior Christmas garlands are twisted around an annealed galvanized wire for rust prevention and enhanced flexibility. UV-stabilized vinyl is used in the manufacture of these products to help them stand up to the rigors of winter. Commercial garland is priced by the foot, so just tell us the length you need and we’ll custom-cut it for you. We also offer our exceptional offering of Taiga Evergreen garland with thick luscious, realistic branches. You are sure to find a Christmas garland to fit your needs.
